title: Intent-Driven Situation Tracking for User-Centric Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.15755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User-centric multi-turn agents must act on an evolving task situation shaped by changing user intents, accumulated tool-grounded facts, missing information, and execution constraints. Existing context-management methods improve the use of past interaction history, but rarely maintain an explicit situation state that separates grounded facts from task-state judgments. As a result, agents often need to infer fine-grained attributes, task dependencies, and constraint satisfaction implicitly from dialogue traces. We propose Intent-Driven Situation States (IDSS), a training-free framework that maintains an explicit situation state alongside the dialogue. IDSS parses tool returns into provenance-aware entities and attributes, tracks user intents, required variables, constraints, and execution status, and propagates new facts to task constraints to update action executability. This allows agents to avoid infeasible actions, advance dependent go

translated_title: 面向用户中心多轮代理的意图驱动情境跟踪
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15755v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用户中心的多轮代理必须应对由不断变化的用户意图、积累的工具事实、缺失信息和执行约束所构成的动态任务情境。现有的上下文管理方法改善了过往交互历史的使用，但很少维护一个显式的情境状态，将已确认的事实与任务状态判断分开。因此，代理通常需要从对话痕迹中隐式推断细粒度属性、任务依赖关系和约束满足情况。我们提出意图驱动情境状态（IDSS），这是一个无需训练的框架，在对话旁边维护一个显式的情境状态。IDSS 将工具返回解析为带有来源的实体和属性，跟踪用户意图、所需变量、约束和执行状态，并将新事实传播到任务约束以更新动作的可执行性。这使得代理能够避免不可行的动作，推进依赖性的目标。
tldr: 本文提出IDSS框架，通过显式维护情境状态，将工具事实与任务判断分离，以提升多轮代理在动态任务中的执行准确性和可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the IDSS framework, which explicitly maintains a situation state to separate grounded facts from task judgments, enhancing execution accuracy and feasibility for multi-turn agents in dynamic tasks.
